name: Phishing: Spearphishing Attachment
detectionLogic: process_name in ('WINWORD.EXE','EXCEL.EXE') AND child_process_name in ('cmd.exe','powershell.exe','wscript.exe') | EventID=4688 AND ParentImage=*Office* AND Image=*powershell*

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
detectionLogic: process_name='powershell.exe' AND (command_line CONTAINS '-enc' OR command_line CONTAINS 'IEX' OR command_line CONTAINS 'DownloadString') | ScriptBlockLogging EventID=4104 with suspicious keywords
